claim_ceiling: Software-contract fixtures only. No case contains measured production data or validates a physical materials model, product grade, furnace, lifecycle result, or manufacturing performance claim.
suite_invariants: At least one valid glass control and one valid MG-Si control must be accepted at the contract level.
All seeded negative controls must be rejected with stable reason codes.
Hold controls must remain abstained or unresolved and must never be silently accepted.
Synthetic values and labels must never be promoted to measured production evidence.
A valid software contract outcome is not a physical-process pass.
A claimed route improvement must be assessed across a frozen scenario grid; one favorable scenario is not sufficient.

research_references.title: Status and prospects of energy efficiency in the glass industry: Measuring, assessing and improving energy performance
research_references.use: Context for glass-furnace energy normalization and best-practice comparison.
research_references.limitation: The reported sectoral improvement potential is not a guaranteed saving for any target plant.

research_references.title: Ontology-Based Digital Infrastructure for Data-Driven Glass Development
research_references.use: State-of-the-art baseline for glass ontology, robotic melting, and ML-based property prediction.
research_references.limitation: Does not by itself establish that this benchmark's cross-route conservation, lifecycle, uncertainty, and industrial decision contract is implemented.

research_references.title: Emerging Technologies for Decarbonizing Silicon Production
research_references.use: Reference context for MG-Si conventional energy/direct-emissions levels and route maturity distinctions.
research_references.limitation: Review figures are contextual ranges and are not a substitute for a matched plant baseline or verified life-cycle assessment.

research_references.title: Recent Advances in Electrochemical-Based Silicon Production Technologies with Reduced Carbon Emission
research_references.use: Research context for electrochemical silicon process families and unresolved scale-up questions.
research_references.limitation: Review of promising technologies is not evidence of commercial-scale competitiveness or qualified product output.

research_references.title: Decarbonising the glass industry: A comprehensive techno-economic assessment of low-emission pathways
research_references.use: Scenario and uncertainty-aware comparison of hybrid furnaces, electrification, hydrogen, and CCS for flat glass.
research_references.limitation: Model outputs depend on the study's declared flat-glass plant, prices, system boundary, and assumptions; do not generalize as measured results for another plant.

research_references.title: Assessing container glass production decarbonization through amine scrubbing, calcium looping and electrification: a comparative techno-economic analysis
research_references.use: Recent modeled comparison of CCS and electrification pathways for a declared 250 t/day container-glass case.
research_references.limitation: Scenario-specific process-model and techno-economic results; not an independently measured universal benchmark.

research_references.title: Techno-Economic Comparison of Molten-Salt Electrolysis and Carbothermic Reduction for the Production of Metallurgical-Grade Silicon
research_references.use: Recent conditional comparison of MG-Si conventional submerged-arc furnace and molten-salt electrolysis economics and energy assumptions.
research_references.limitation: MSE for MG-Si has not been deployed at modeled industrial scale; inputs and cost results have high scale-up/financing uncertainty and are not validated plant performance.

research_references.title: Digital Twins Workshops Summary Report (NISTIR 8620)
research_references.use: Manufacturing digital-twin concerns including interoperability, VVUQ, cybersecurity, and supply-chain resilience.
research_references.limitation: Workshop synthesis and research priorities, not a glass- or silicon-specific process-performance standard.

cases.purpose: Verify that a glass candidate with the required contract fields can proceed to independent physics and evidence evaluation.
cases.claim_ceiling: Acceptance confirms contract completeness only; no glass recipe, melt, energy saving, or product quality is validated.

cases.purpose: Verify that the MG-Si reference route declares grade, boundary, and balance authority without inferring electronic-grade capability.
cases.claim_ceiling: Acceptance confirms contract completeness only; no silicon yield, purity, energy, emissions, or commercial readiness is validated.

cases.purpose: Reject a quantitative claim whose source cannot be identified or reproduced.
Reject a candidate that substitutes zero for unavailable energy or cost and appears better because evidence is missing.
Reject non-finite or physically invalid quantities and unconverted incompatible units.
cases.claim_ceiling: Tests schema-level quantity handling only; it is not a numerical process solver.

cases.purpose: Force unresolved status when material streams or the justified tolerance are missing rather than manufacturing a pass.
cases.claim_ceiling: Tests incomplete-balance abstention only; no element-balance accuracy is established.

cases.purpose: Reject an MG-Si result presented as electronic-grade silicon, wafer-grade feedstock, or a qualified semiconductor input without downstream evidence.
Reject an unqualified comparison between unlike glass families, silicon grades, or accepted-product denominators.
Reject emissions or cost results that credit slag, silica fume, heat, or other coproducts without an evidenced usable outlet and declared allocation.
Reject a route ranking when one candidate includes upstream electricity, reductants, transport, or waste treatment and its comparator does not.
Reject a synthetic or simulated value relabeled as an observed production result.
Reject a candidate accepted outside the model's validated domain without explicit review or new evidence.
Reject a benchmark evaluation that leaks the same material lot, furnace campaign, or duplicated source into training and evaluation.
Reject evidence used outside its declared validity window or permitted use.
Reject scalar-score improvements that mask a product-grade violation, yield loss, or defect increase.
Suite-level meta-check: the benchmark must not pass if the verifier rejects every candidate.
cases.claim_ceiling: Tests benchmark-policy completeness only; it is not a physical case.

cases.purpose: Reject a claim that ranks a process route using only one favorable price, grid-carbon, capacity-factor, financing, or feedstock scenario.
cases.claim_ceiling: Tests scenario robustness metadata only; it does not validate a techno-economic model.
